cues.text: In the music room, Ryoji sits alone at the grand piano, turned away from the keys with his hands resting on his knee. You walk over to him.
Ryoji turns to the keys and plays, his eyes closed.
Fuuka comes in through the door with her school bag, and you turn toward her.
You look back at the piano. The bench is empty: Ryoji is gone. Fuuka walks over to stand beside you.
